_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Residential (segment principal Orkin), Commercial (croissance B2B), Termite & ancillary (services premium), Total revenues.

kpis.signal: Segment leader ~45% du CA, Orkin/HomeTeam, croissance double digit recurrente
kpis.description_fr: Services pest control residentiel (rongeurs, insectes, faune). Pilier Rollins, environ 45% du CA total. Croissance organique + M&A.
kpis.description_en: Residential pest control services (rodents, insects, wildlife). Rollins core pillar, ~45% of total revenue. Organic + M&A growth.

kpis.signal: Pest control B2B (sante, foodservice, logistique), ~33% du CA, croissance acceleree
kpis.description_fr: Pest control commercial B2B : hopitaux, restauration, logistique. ~33% du CA. Croissance double digit FY25.
kpis.description_en: B2B commercial pest control: healthcare, foodservice, logistics. ~33% of revenue. Double-digit FY25 growth.

kpis.signal: Croissance la plus rapide (~14%), traitements termites premium, marges elevees
kpis.description_fr: Services termites + completions, bait monitoring, renouvellements. Segment a plus forte croissance (CAGR ~14%).
kpis.description_en: Termite services + completions, bait monitoring, renewals. Fastest-growing segment (CAGR ~14%).

kpis.signal: CAGR 5 ans ~11%, croissance reguliere combinant organique + bolt-on acquisitions
kpis.description_fr: CA consolide Rollins. CAGR 5 ans ~11%. Mix organique (~7-8%) + acquisitions bolt-on (~3-4%).
kpis.description_en: Rollins consolidated revenue. 5y CAGR ~11%. Mix organic (~7-8%) + bolt-on M&A (~3-4%).

kpis.signal: ~93% du CA aux Etats-Unis, exposition domestique quasi-totale
kpis.description_fr: CA Etats-Unis. ~93% du CA total. Faible exposition internationale (~7% autres pays).
kpis.description_en: U.S. revenue. ~93% of total. Low international exposure (~7% other countries).
